subject: Slot harmonization request — joint AWS & GCP SI co-sell demo
messages:
From: Tim Smith <tim.smith@nebulaworks.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: partners@nebulaworks.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Request: joint demo with AWS & GCP SIs — proposed windows

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the intro last week. NebulaWorks is excited to run a joint co-sell demo with Redwood and our two SI partners (AWS SI: CloudAnchor, GCP SI: SkyBridge). The goal is a 45–60 minute session that covers:
- 15m business overview (NebulaWorks + Redwood)
- 25–30m technical deep-dive (model selection, latency/quantization tradeoffs, routing)
- 10–15m live Q&A and next steps

Proposed windows (all in US Eastern):
- Wed 21 Apr — 10:30–11:30
- Thu 22 Apr — 14:00–15:00
- Fri 23 Apr — 16:00–17:00

Could you confirm who from Redwood should lead the tech portion? We want to finalize the runbook and get a single calendar invite out. Also please confirm if Redwood has a one-pager for the marketplace listing so we can attach it to our internal enablement doc.

I've CC'd the partner coordinator alias. If any of those slots don't work, share alternatives and we'll compress to a 30-minute run if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

—Tim
Tim Smith
Head of Partnerships, NebulaWorks
(t) 415-555-0187

Attachment: none (will share runbook when you confirm)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Tim Smith <tim.smith@nebulaworks.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: joint demo with AWS & GCP SIs — proposed windows

Tim — thanks, great framing. Quick notes:
- Recommended format: 30m technical deep-dive + 15m customer Q&A + 15m executive wrap (keeps live demo risk low). If partners insist on a 60m runtime we can do it, but we prefer a tighter technical slot.
- Tech lead: Vanessa Ortiz (Cloud Partnerships) will present the runtime/ops + model-routing story; Kimberly Park will cover marketplace packaging and partner enablement. I'll own logistics and escalation.

Our high-level availability (ET):
- Wed 21 Apr — available 09:00–11:45 (10:30 OK)
- Thu 22 Apr — available 13:30–15:30 (14:00 OK)
- Fri 23 Apr — limited (16:00 works if condensed to 30–40m)

I'll attach our demo runbook and a short one-pager for the marketplace listing so you can share with CloudAnchor/SkyBridge. Also proposing the following attendees from our side: Vanessa, Kimberly, Vivek (ops/infra). Can you confirm the SI leads and whether they need VPN/network checks or test accounts?

Sharing attachments: demo-runbook.pdf (run order + roles), co-sell-one-pager.pdf (marketplace blurb). Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBq-demo-runbook

If you want, I'll send a compact calendar invite for Thu 22 Apr 14:00 ET and mark it as 'Proposed' until partners confirm.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Global SI Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo-runbook.pdf, co-sell-one-pager.pdf

From: Tim Smith <tim.smith@nebulaworks.com>

Date: 2027-04-18T11:40:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: joint demo with AWS & GCP SIs — proposed windows

Markus — perfect, thanks. CloudAnchor and SkyBridge both tentatively confirmed Thu 22 Apr 14:00 ET.

CloudAnchor will need a quick network handshake for the demo (VPN tunnel is not expected, but we should confirm outbound port allowances). SkyBridge asked if we can move the session 30 minutes later to 14:30 ET to accommodate a client call — is that possible for your team?

If 14:30 works, we can finalize and I'll push an .ics to everyone. If not, we can keep 14:00 and SkyBridge will dial in at the end for Q&A only.

Proposed calendar invite: calendar-invite.ics (will send once you confirm).

—Tim

Thanks — quick operational asks from the Redwood side:

1) Can we land on 14:30 ET on Thu 22 Apr? That gives SkyBridge the 30-minute buffer they requested and still fits our presenter schedules.
2) Format suggestion: 30m tech + 10m Q&A + 10m exec wrap (50m total). Keeps the flow tight.
3) Please confirm SI leads + short bios (1–2 lines each) so we can include them on the invite and in the runbook.
4) Network check: Vivek, can you run a pre-demo connectivity test with CloudAnchor? Ideally the test happens Wed 21 Apr 11:00–11:30 ET.

We want the runbook to call out fallback hosts and a short checklist for model/seq-length used during the live walkthrough to avoid surprise token/perf regressions. I've attached an ops-focused supplement we typically use.

Attachment: co-sell-one-pager.pdf

—Vanessa
